about: The judgments Jev answers for the inbox brief. Code supplies the state and owns the policy (thresholds, weights, labels). Placeholders: {{owner}}, {{role}}, {{i}} (event index in state.events).

thread.state: { owner: {name, role}, today, thread: { subject, counterpart: {name, email, known_relationship}, other_participants[], message_count, last_message_from_owner, days_since_last_message, recent_messages: [{from, sent, text}] } }

category.instructions: Which area of {{owner}}'s work is `thread` mainly about? {{owner}} is the owner of this inbox.

criteria.client_delivery: Work for an existing client: engagements, deliverables, workshops, feedback, scheduling client sessions
criteria.new_business: Winning new work: enquiries, prospects, proposals, pricing, introductions to potential clients
criteria.partnerships_speaking: Partnerships, collaborations, speaking, media, podcasts, advisory boards, community
criteria.finance_admin: Invoices, payments, contracts, legal, tax, insurance, accounts, suppliers
criteria.team_ops: Running {{owner}}'s own business: associates, contractors, tools, internal planning
criteria.personal: Personal or family matters unrelated to work
criteria.automated_notification: Machine-generated message from a system or service, with no person expecting a reply

needs_owner_action.instructions: Considering the whole of `thread`, is someone waiting on {{owner}} (the owner) for a reply, decision, approval, information or deliverable that the thread does not show {{owner}} has already given?

criteria.true: Yes: a question, request or proposal is addressed to {{owner}} and is still unanswered or undelivered
criteria.false: No: nothing is outstanding from {{owner}}; the thread is informational, already answered, or closed with thanks

awaiting_others.instructions: Considering the whole of `thread`, is {{owner}} (the owner) waiting on someone else for a reply, decision, document or action that has not yet arrived in the thread?

owner_commitment_open.instructions: Did {{owner}} (the owner) personally commit in `thread` to do something (send, review, introduce, call, deliver) that later messages do not show as done?

relationship_risk.instructions: Does `thread` show a risk to {{owner}}'s relationship with the other party: dissatisfaction, complaint, escalation, frustration at slow response, a dispute, or a threat to cancel?

urgency.instructions: How time-critical is `thread` for {{owner}} as of `today`?
criteria: No time pressure: informational, or no action needed
Weeks: something to handle this month
This week: needs handling within the next few working days
Immediate: due within 48 hours, overdue, or explicitly marked urgent

strategic_value.instructions: How much does `thread` matter to {{owner}}'s business, given their role as {{role}}?
criteria: Significant: active client work, revenue, or a relationship that matters
Material: new revenue opportunity, senior executive stakeholder, or contractual, financial or reputational stakes

deadline.optional: Asked only when code found date phrases; code adds one option per candidate (d1…d6) before `none`.
deadline.instructions: Each option is a date mentioned in `thread`, already resolved to a calendar date. Which one is a deadline or scheduled commitment that {{owner}} (the owner) must act on or attend? A date that is only background, in the past, or someone else's commitment is not.

criteria.none: None of these is a deadline or commitment for {{owner}}

bulk.state: { reader: {name, role, focus_areas[]}, email: {from, subject, text} }

kind.instructions: What kind of automated or bulk email is `email`?

criteria.newsletter_research: Editorial newsletter, research digest, analysis or industry news
criteria.event_invitation: Invitation to a conference, webinar, meetup or other event
criteria.marketing_promo: Product marketing, promotion, sale or sales outreach sent in bulk
criteria.product_notification: Automated notice from a tool or service: activity, alerts, reminders, digests of app activity
criteria.billing_receipt: Invoice, receipt, payment, subscription or billing notice
criteria.security_account: Security alert, sign-in notice, password or account change

relevance.instructions: How useful is `email` to `reader`, given their role and `reader.focus_areas`?
criteria: No use: unrelated to their work or interests, or pure promotion
Marginal: loosely related; safe to skip
Useful: substantive content on one of their focus areas worth a skim this week
High value: insight, data, opportunity or event directly relevant to their advisory work that they would regret missing

event.state: { owner: {name, role}, today, events: [{ title, when, attendees[], known_relationship, description, open_email_threads[] }] }
event.perItem: Question names are prefixed e{{i}}_ ; `prep` is asked only for upcoming events.

type.instructions: What kind of meeting is `events[{{i}}]` for {{owner}}?

criteria.client: Working session, review or check-in with an existing client
criteria.new_business: Sales conversation, discovery call, pitch or proposal meeting with a prospective client
criteria.partner_network: Partner, collaborator, speaking, media, investor or networking meeting
criteria.internal: Internal: {{owner}}'s own associates, contractors or suppliers

prep.instructions: How much preparation does {{owner}} need before `events[{{i}}]`? Consider its purpose, attendees and `events[{{i}}].open_email_threads`.
criteria: None: routine or recurring; walk in as is
Light: skim notes or the latest thread beforehand
Moderate: review materials, decide positions, or resolve an open email thread first
Substantial: a deck, proposal, analysis or decision must be ready; senior or high-stakes audience
